identity: ONE original mechanical artillery construct, the Aurora Ballista veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the ivory enamel armour plates with polished brass and bronze joints, the central round brass pedestal, the violet-blue faceted crystal drum, the THREE long parallel firing rails held in brass bands and tipped with pointed blue crystals, the large brass spoked handwheel on the near side, and EXACTLY THREE articulated ivory and brass legs ending in pointed brass feet. No crew, rider, wheels or extra legs. Preserve the three rails, the handwheel, the crystal drum and the rigid machine proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed scale and centred body. Keep every crystal tip and all three feet within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, smoke, beams, bolts, sparks, motion trails, particles, crew or extra legs; the crystals keep only their steady blue glow. The machine moves only at its joints and pivots; the rails, drum and armour plates stay rigid and never bend or morph.

idle_h3_v1.action: A mechanical scanning idle that loops. The side handwheel turns slowly, the rail bundle elevates a few degrees to scan and the turret pans a little on its pedestal, then the rails lower and everything returns smoothly to the original level ready position. All three feet stay planted; the legs flex only slightly at the knees. No walking and no firing.

move_h3_v1.action: Walk in place on the three legs through two complete cycles. One leg at a time lifts at its knee, swings forward and plants on its pointed foot while the other two bear the weight, in a steady rotating order. The turret and rails stay level and centred for engine-driven travel with only a small counter-sway. Exactly three legs at all times. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE melee ram toward screen right. The machine lowers its rail bundle toward a nearby target and the rear legs bend, loading force, then the front feet brace and the body shoves forward so the rigid rail housing strikes at full reach at screen right with all three rails still attached, the front legs compress absorbing the contact, then the body recoils back and settles level into the original ready position. One ram only; nothing is fired.

ranged_h3_v1.action: Fire ONE volley toward screen right. The legs brace and the rails elevate a few degrees, the handwheel and crystal drum rotate to cock, then the three rails kick sharply back into their housing in recoil as the machine rocks back on its legs, stay compressed a moment, spring forward again as the handwheel turns to reload, and the rails lower to the original level ready position. The shot itself is not shown: no bolt, beam, flash or muzzle effect.

hit_h3_v1.action: Start rocked back in a flinch, then recover completely. The chassis jolts back and the turret tilts, the leg joints compress and the rails yaw slightly away, then the springs recover and the machine returns to the same level ready position. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Brace defensively: the turret lowers closer to the body, the three legs spread wider and bend at the knees, and the machine locks into a low sturdy brace with the rails held level forward, then holds the guard on all three planted feet. No firing and no return to the ready height.

cast_h3_v1.action: A mechanical salute acknowledging a command. The handwheel turns and the elevation mount raises the rail bundle steeply upward to a clear salute, holds it there with a small nod of the mount, then lowers the rails back to level in the original ready position. The feet stay planted. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow change or effect.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse mechanically. The crystals dim and the near leg buckles, the chassis leans as a knee fails and the rail bundle dips, then the front support folds and the body tips slowly onto its side, the housing settling on the ground with the legs folded under it and a few small loose gears dropping beside it, finishing as an inert grounded wreck with all three rails still recognisable and the crystals dark. The same body throughout: no explosion, no shrinking and no disappearing.
